SpaceRescue is a backend system for managing spaceships, rescue missions and mission assignments.

The project is built with:
Node.js
Express
MongoDB
Mongoose
JavaScript
REST API

General Development Rules

- When working on this project, you must:
- Read the relevant GitHub Issue before making changes.
- Inspect the existing project structure and code before implementing anything.
- Only implement functionality related to the current Issue.
- Avoid changing unrelated files or existing functionality.
- Follow the existing naming conventions and coding style.
- Use async/await for asynchronous operations.
- Handle errors explicitly.
- Write clear and understandable code.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and abstractions.
- Do not assume that functionality works without testing it.
- If requirements are unclear or conflict with the existing implementation, explain the problem and ask for clarification instead of making major assumptions.
